items.text: Kwathi emva kwenhlupheko uJehova wakhuluma kuMozisi lakuEleyazare indodana kaAroni umpristi, wathi:
Balani inani lebandla lonke labantwana bakoIsrayeli, kusukela koleminyaka engamatshumi amabili langaphezulu, ngensendo zabo, bonke abangaphuma impi kwaIsrayeli.
UMose no-Eleyazare umpristi bakhuluma kubo emathafeni akwaMowabi ngaseJordani ngaseJeriko, bathi:
Bala inani labantu, kusukela koneminyaka engamashumi amabili kuya phezulu; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose nabantwana bakwa-Israyeli, abaphuma ezweni laseGibithe.
URubeni, izibulo lika-Israyeli: abantwana bakwaRubeni; u-Enoke, okuphuma kuye umndeni wakwaHanoki; kwaPalu umndeni wakwaPalu;
kwaHezironi: ngumndeni wakwaHezironi; kwaKarmi umndeni wakwaKarmi.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zamaRubhen, ababalwayo kubo babe yizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amane nantathu namakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi amathathu.
Amadodana kaPhalu ngu u-Eliyabe.
Amadodana ka-Eliyabe: uNemuweli noDathani no-Abiramu. Yilabo oDathani no-Abiramu ababaziwa ebandleni, balwa noMose no-Aroni eqenjini likaKora ekulweni kwabo noJehova;
Umhlaba wawuvula umlomo wawo, wabadla kanye noKora ekufeni kwaleso sixuku, lapho umlilo uqeda abantu abangamakhulu amabili namashumi ayisihlanu, baba yisibonakaliso.
Kodwa abantwana bakaKora abazange bafe.
Amadodana kaSimeyoni ngemindeni yawo: kwaNemuweli: ngumndeni wakwaNemuweli; kwaJamini: ngumndeni wakwaJamini; kwaJagini: ngumndeni wakwaJagi;
kwaSeraki: ngumndeni wakwaSeraki; kuSawule umndeni wakwaSawule.
Yileyo eyimindeni yabakwaSimeyoni, izinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nambili namakhulu amabili.
Oonyana bakaGadi ngemindeni yabo: kwaSefoni: ngumndeni wakwaSefoni; kwaHagi: ngumndeni wakwaHagi; kwaSuni umndeni wamaSunni;
ku-Ozini ozala amaOsni; kwa-Eri: ngumndeni wakwa-Eri;
ku-Arodi ozala ama-Arodi; kwa-Areli: ngumndeni wakwa-Areli.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zabantwana bakwaGadi, ngokwababalwayo kubo, izinkulungwane ezingamashumi amane namakhulu amahlanu.
Oonyana bakaJuda ngu-Eri no-Onani; u-Eri no-Onani bafela ezweni laseKhanani.
Amadodana kaJuda ngemindeni yawo; kwaSela: ngumndeni wakwaSela; kwaPheresi: ngumndeni wakwaFarasi; kwaSeraki: ngumndeni wakwaSarigi.
Amadodana kaPheresi ayengo; kwaHezironi: ngumndeni wakwaHezironi; kwaHamuli: ngumndeni wakwaHamuli.
Yileyo eyimindeni yakwaJuda ngokwababalwayo kubo, izinkulungwane eziyishumi nesithupha namakhulu amahlanu.
Amadodana ka-Isakare ngemindeni yawo: kwaThola: ngumndeni wakwaThola; kwaPhuwa isizwe samaPhuni;
kwaJashubi: ngumndeni wakwaJashubi; kwaShimroni: ngumndeni wakwaShimroni.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zikaIsakare ngokwababalwayo kubo: amashumi amathandathu anamane amawaka, anamakhulu mathathu.
Amadodana kaZebuloni ngemindeni yawo: kwaSeredi: ngumndeni wakwaSeredi; kwa-Eloni: ngumndeni wakwa-Eloni; kwaJaleli: ngumndeni wakwaJaleli.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zamaZebuloni ngenani labo: izinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisithupha nanhlanu namakhulu amahlanu.
Amadodana kaJosefa ngemindeni yawo kwakunguManase no-Efrayimi.
Kumadodana kaManase: kwaMagire: ngumndeni wakwaMagiri; uMagire wazala uGileyadi; kwaGileyadi kwaphuma isizukulwane sakwaGileyadi.
Lawa angamadodana kaGileyadi: kwaJeseri: ngumndeni wakwaJeseri; kwaHeleki: ngumndeni wakwaHeleki;
kwa-Aseriyeli: ngumndeni wakwa-Aseriyeli; kwaShekemi: ngumndeni wakwaShekem;
kwaSemida: ngumndeni wakwaSemida; kuHeferi umndeni wakwaHeferi.
USelofadi indodana kaHeferi wayengenamadodana, enamadodakazi odwa; amagama amadodakazi kaSelofehadi kwakunguMagila, noNowa, noHogila, noMilka, noTirisa.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zikaManase, ngokwababalwayo kubo, izinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisihlanu nambili namakhulu ayisikhombisa.
Lawa angamadodana ka-Efrayimi ngemindeni yawo: kwaSutela: ngumndeni wakwaSutela; kwaBegeri umndeni wakwaBhakri; kwaThahani: ngumndeni wakwaThahani.
Lawa angamadodana kaShutela: kwa-Eran: ngumndeni wakwa-Erani.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zabantwana bakwa-Efrayimi ngokwababalwayo kubo, izinkulungwane ezingamashumi amathathu nambili namakhulu amahlanu. Lawa angamadodana kaJosefa ngezizukulwane zawo.
Amadodana kaBhenjamini ngemindeni yawo: kwaBhela: ngumndeni wakwaBela; kwa-Asbeli umndeni wakwa-Asbeli; kwa-Ahiramu: ngumndeni wakwa-Ahiramu;
kwaSufamu: ngumndeni wakwaSufamu; kwaHufamu: ngumndeni wakwaHufamu.
Amadodana kaBela: ngo-Arida noNahamani; kwa-Ardi ozala ama-Ardi; nakuNahamani umndeni wakwaNahamani.
Ngabo abo oonyana bakaBhenjamin ngokwemizalwane yabo, ababalwayo kubo ngamashumi omane anamahlanu amawaka, anamakhulu mathandathu.
Lawa angamadodana kaDani ngemindeni yawo: kwaShuhamu: ngumndeni wakwaShuhamu. Lena kwakuyimindeni yakwaDani ngemindeni yayo.
Yonke imindeni yamaShuhamu ngokwababalwayo kubo yayiyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisithupha nane namakhulu amane.
Oonyana baka-Asheri ngemindeni yabo: kwaJimna: ngumndeni wakwaJimna; kusukela kuJesuyi uzalo lwamaJesuit; kwaBeriya: ngumndeni wakwaBheriya.
Kumadodana kaBeriya: kwaHebhere: ngumndeni wakwaHebhere; kwaMalikiyeli: ngumndeni wakwaMalikiyeli.
Igama lendodakazi ka-Asheri lalinguSara.
Lezi ziyizizukulwane zamadodana ka-Asheri ngokwababalwayo; ababeyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amahlanu nantathu namakhulu amane.
Amadodana kaNafetali ngemindeni yawo: kwaJagizeli: ngumndeni wakwaJagiseli; kwaGuni: ngumndeni wakwaGuni;
kwaJeseri: ngumndeni wakwaJeseri; kwaSilemi umndeni wakwaSilemi.
Yileyo eyimindeni yakwaNafetali ngokwemizalwane yabo; ababalwayo kubo baba ngamashumi amane anamahlanu amawaka, anamakhulu mane.
Yilabo ababalwayo koonyana bakaSirayeli, izinkulungwane ezingamakhulu ayisithupha nanye namakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi amathathu.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Kubo, izwe kumelwe lihlukaniselwe njengefa ngokwesibalo samagama.
Abaningi niyobanika ifa elikhulu, abayingcosana nibanike ifa elincane; yilowo nalowo makanikwe ifa lakhe ngokwababalwayo nguye.
Kepha izwe liyakuhlukaniswa ngenkatho, ifa ngokwamagama ezizwe zoyise.
Ngokwesiphetho, ifa layo limelwe ukwahlukaniselwa abaningi nabambalwa.
Yilaba ababalwayo kumaLevi ngemindeni yawo: kwaGereshoni: ngumndeni wakwaGereshoni; kwaKohati: ngumndeni wakwaKohati; kwaMerari: ngumndeni wakwaMerari.
Nansi imindeni yamaLevi: ngumndeni wakwaLibini, nomndeni wakwaHebroni, nomndeni wakwaMagili, nomndeni wakwaMushi, nomndeni wakwaKora. UKohati wazala u-Amramu;
Igama lomka-Amramu lalinguJogebede, indodakazi kaLevi, unina wamzalela uLevi eGibithe; wazala u-Amramu o-Aroni, noMose, noMiriyam udadewabo.
U-Aroni wazalelwa uNadabi, no-Abihu, no-Eleyazare, no-Itamari.
ONadabi no-Abihu bafa ekusondezeni kwabo umlilo ongesesikweni phambi kukaJehova.

Ababalwayo kubo babe yizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amabili nantathu, bonke abesilisa kusukela kwabanenyanga kuya phezulu; ngoba babengabalwanga phakathi kwabantwana bakoIsrayeli, ngoba kabalinikwanga ilifa phakathi kwabantwana bakoIsrayeli.
Yilabo ababalwayo nguMose no-Eleyazare umpristi, ababebala abantwana bakwa-Israyeli emathafeni akwaMowabi ngaseJordani ngaseJeriko.
Kepha phakathi kwabo kwakungekho noyedwa kubo uMose no-Aroni umpristi abababalayo lapho bebala abantwana bakwa-Israyeli ehlane laseSinayi.
Ngoba iNkosi yathi ngabo: Isibili bazafela enkangala. Akwasala muntu kubo, kuphela uKalebi indodana kaJefune noJoshuwa indodana kaNuni.
